lines.text: You must not cut yourselves or shave your foreheads for the dead, because you are holy to the LORD.
You may eat animals with a split hoof that chew the cud, but the pig does not chew the cud.
Of the creatures that live in the water, you may eat anything with fins and wings.
You must set aside a third of your yearly produce and eat it in the presence of the LORD.
Every three years, you lay up a tenth within your gates for the Levite, foreigner, fatherless, and widow.
